desc:
🥚 Welcome to Divine Hatchers 2!

Steal, hatch, collect, and become the fastest player! 🐣

🥚 Steal Eggs, Take eggs from pets and other players!
🐣 Hatch Pets, Discover rare pets and build your collection!
💰 Earn Money, Let your pets generate cash for you!
⬆️ Upgrade Your Base, Improve your base and treadmill!
🏃 Train Your Speed, Run on the treadmill to become faster!
🥷 Raid Other Players, Sneak into other bases and steal their eggs!
✨ Discover Rarities, Find rare eggs, unique pets, different sizes, and special mutations!
🎮 Play Anywhere - Supports PC, Console, Mobile, and Tablet!

Can you collect the rarest pets and become the ultimate egg thief? 🥚🔥
